**Coaching Note (80 words max):**

You had a pawn just one square from queening—always look for this! When your pawn can promote with check, it forces your opponent to deal with it immediately. Here, promoting to a queen gives check AND creates unstoppable threats: if White's knight recaptures (2.Nxc1), you have Qd1 mate on the back rank. If the queen recaptures (2.Qxc1), you trade queens favorably and maintain control. Advanced players spot promotion checks first—they're nearly always winning.
